**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mrs Valentine](../persons.html#1437),
I have got my Armada story home, and on looking over it, I think it will answer your purpose very well, but I must copy it out again to take out the real names and to improve it. I suppose about 70 or 80pp of the size of the specimen I send which is the first chapter.[^1]
Please return it, when you have glanced over it, and tell me if it will do.

The scenery is real, but I have changed the names and transposed that of the river - the Yealm. I think the boat would make a pretty illustration.

How ingeniously the young ladies playing at games have been varied in the Home Book!

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: It sounds as if Valentine had solicited a contribution to one of the annuals she edited for Warne.
